batchSize.description:
Number of messages to receive in each receiveMessages call
For AwsSqs, ensure this number is less than or equal to 10

timeoutMillis.description: Time in milliseconds receiver waits for the next event before receiver stops listening.

partition.description: The partition of the cloud stream that receiveMessages reads data from

sequenceNumber.description:
receiveMessages reads data starting from this sequence number.
If this field is not specified, receiveMessages reads from start of stream.
Here number is represented as string to support large numbers some cloud streams use e.g {@link AwsKinesis}
uses sequenceNumber which is string of digits up to 128.

cloudConsumer.description: Name of cloud consumer used to read messages

fromEnd.description:
If true, indicates that the peek operation should be starting from the end of the visible messages list
and return the last a few messages in the list.
